# GravityPort

> GravityPort is a free AI asset manager for ChatGPT, Gemini, Flow, Google AI Studio, Codex, Grok and Jimeng. It saves generated images and videos straight to a library on your own computer, with their prompts, reference images and sources.

GravityPort doesn't generate images. It collects them, automatically, from the tools you already use, and runs on Macs with Apple silicon and on Windows 10/11.

## What it does

- Auto-Capture: Saves generated images and videos straight to your library. ChatGPT, Gemini, Flow, Google AI Studio and Jimeng through the browser extension; Codex and Grok read directly by the desktop app.
- Prompts & Context: Keeps prompts, reference images, and sources with every asset.
- Version Tree: Records every round of edits in a conversation. Images from one ChatGPT conversation line up round by round; compare any two side by side and see which line changed it.
- Smart Stacks: Groups related assets by source and conversation. Images from one conversation, Flow project or Codex task stack into a single card.
- 100% Local: Stores all assets and records locally on your computer.
- GravityPort MCP: Lets AI assistants manage your library assets directly. Connect Claude or Codex to search and use assets, prompts, versions and generation history.
- Free Download: macOS · Windows · gravityport.azhuilab.com

## Privacy

- No account, no cloud, no sync, no uploads. Originals, Prompts and sources live in a folder you choose.
- The extension sends images and their source details only to GravityPort on your computer.
- The desktop app only goes online on its own to check for updates and send an anonymous activity signal at most once a day, neither with assets, Prompts, file names or paths.
